_howto: Copy to brands/promotions/<brand-id>.json. One entry per offer per set of markets. Field reference: docs/types/promo.md, section 2.

promotions.type: welcome_bonus | deposit_bonus | free_bets | promo_code | odds_boost | cashback | loyalty | tournaments
promotions._value_kinds: match {percent,max} | boost {percent} | cashback {percent,max} | free_bets {amount} | free_spins {count} | prize_pool {amount}
promotions.code: TODO or null when no code is needed
promotions.code_scope: public | exclusive (exclusive only if the code is really unique to this site)
promotions.verified_at: YYYY-MM-DD (date someone last checked the offer on the brand's site)
promotions.terms_url: https://TODO full T&Cs on the brand's site
